{
  "name_a": "Snow-free surfaces",
  "name_b": "Snow-covered terrain",
  "definition": "A patch lies closer to A when it shows less visible ground snow or ice: predominantly vegetation, bare ground, or dark open water. B has extensive or patchy snow, appearing white in true color and bright cyan in false color, interspersed with darker terrain. Distinguish ground-following snow from clouds.",
  "cues": [
    "White areas in true color that turn bright cyan in false color favor B.",
    "Irregular snow patches tracing terrain and filling gaps among dark vegetation or rock favor B.",
    "Green vegetation turning strongly red, including clear agricultural parcels, favors A.",
    "Broad, uniformly dark water without bright snow or ice favors A."
  ],
  "visible": "high"
}
